name: AEON Thana Sinsap (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: AEON Thana Sinsap (Thailand) Public Company Limited provides various retail finance services in Thailand and internationally. It operates through Retail Finance Services and Other Business segments. The company offers credit cards, hire purchase, personal loans, and other services; and debt collection and insurance brokerage services, as well as microfinance services. In addition, it engages in non-life and life insurance brokerage services; retail finance business; securitization projects; and non-performing assets management business. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
